cases.question: Can I extend a Graduate visa?
cases.answer: You cannot extend a Graduate visa under any circumstances [graduate-overview#4]. You must apply to switch to a different route such as a Skilled Worker visa before your current visa expires [graduate-overview#4].
cases.reviewer_notes: Answer supported with valid citations [2]. Point coverage: 2/2.

cases.question: How long can I stay on a Graduate visa?
cases.answer: If you’re not eligible for a Graduate visa, you may be eligible for another type of visa to stay in the UK  [graduate-overview#2]. A Graduate visa gives you permission to stay in the UK for at least 18 months after successfully completing an eligible course in the UK [graduate-overview#1].
cases.reviewer_notes: Answer supported with valid citations [2]. Point coverage: 2/2.

cases.question: Can I switch from a Graduate visa to Skilled Worker?
cases.answer: However, you may be able to switch to a different visa, for example a Skilled Worker visa  [graduate-overview#4]. You must leave the UK and apply for a Skilled Worker visa from abroad if you’re in one of these categories [skilled-worker-switching#4].
cases.reviewer_notes: Answer supported with valid citations [2]. Point coverage: 2/2.

cases.question: What are approved employers for Skilled Worker?
cases.answer: You must have a job offer from an approved UK employer before you apply for a Skilled Worker visa [skilled-worker-your-job#9]. A Skilled Worker visa allows you to come to or stay in the UK to do an eligible job with an approved employer [skilled-worker-overview#1].
cases.reviewer_notes: Answer supported with valid citations [2]. Point coverage: 2/3.

cases.question: Where do salary exceptions for Skilled Worker apply?
cases.answer: You might still be able to apply for a Skilled Worker visa if your job is eligible but your salary is less than the standard salary requirement of £41,700 or your job’s standard ‘going rate’ [skilled-worker-salary-exceptions#1]. The immigration salary list is a list of skilled jobs which have lower salary requirements [skilled-worker-salary-exceptions#2].
cases.reviewer_notes: Answer supported with valid citations [2]. Point coverage: 1/4.

cases.question: What documents do I need for a Skilled Worker application?
cases.answer: If your application is successful, your decision email will tell you what you’ll get to prove your immigration status and what you need to do next [skilled-worker-overview#9]. As part of your application you’ll need to prove your identity [skilled-worker-switching#7].

cases.answer: Visa approval is never guaranteed; applicants must meet all statutory Home Office criteria [graduate-overview#11].
